comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper stop; PR-1276 reloads a spring-return long-arm stapler and staples two sheets.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires simultaneous driver and wrench control; PR-1276 holds a sprung magazine open, inserts and seats a staple strip, handles paper and presses the stapler.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires angular retention and repeatable cycles; PR-1276 requires the stapler loaded, sheets physically stapled together, mechanisms still and arms clear.
comparison.reason: Holding a magazine open during loading and subsequently firing a staple does not test preserving a screw adjustment during jam-nut locking; no rubric details are missing.
